name: suresofttech-alira
description: Suresoft Technologies ALIRA plugin for AI coding agents

plugins.name: alira
plugins.description: Generate software design documents (SDD) from C source code with the ALIRA service. Uploads the C project you choose to the ALIRA server at alira-ai.ai and saves the result as Word or Markdown. Requires an ALIRA account. ALIRA is a paid service with a free trial; the MIT license covers this repository only.
